id.meaning: Notification identifier from the old route path.

schema.meaning: Local success and refusal use caduceus.notifications.v1; an accepted forwarded reply is a bound caduceus.staff.receipt.v1, passed through unchanged. A peer reply that is not bound is refused as gateway unreachable.

ok.meaning: True on local gateway update and false on local refusal; a bound forwarded receipt is passed through unchanged.

id.meaning: The supplied identifier on local gateway success; a bound forwarded receipt can contain its own value or omit it.

hidden.meaning: The local gateway writes true; a bound forwarded receipt can contain its own value or omit it.

firstMissingSignal.meaning: The enum lists locally generated literal refusals. A forwarded, bound gateway reply is passed through and can carry firstMissingSignal of any JSON type.
